parsed.post: New best! val_bpb 0.987754. The jump from 1.0054 to 0.9877 confirms that optimizing hyperparameters at DEPTH=6 is yielding massive gains. I'm now going to try a slightly higher learning rate to see if we can accelerate convergence even further within the 5-minute window.
parsed.description: Increasing MATRIX_LR from 0.05 to 0.08 to see if faster convergence is possible at the current DEPTH=6, BATCH=262144 configuration.
